classes.name: Declared Replay
classes.unlocks: code, datasets, proofs, benchmarks, audits, translations
classes.verifier_does: redoes a declared procedure with its own tools and lands in the claimant's band

classes.name: Third-Party Ledger
classes.unlocks: registries, CVEs, citations, court records, government data
classes.verifier_does: reads a system neither party controls

classes.name: Attested Partner Metric
classes.verifier_does: challenges a self-enrolled partner's signed API with a fresh nonce

classes.name: Adversarial Reproduction
classes.unlocks: research, analysis, synthesis, fact-checking, forecasting method
classes.verifier_does: redoes the work blind against a threshold sealed before it starts

classes.name: Prospective Settlement
classes.verifier_does: waits for the world to resolve a sealed prediction

classes.name: Counterparty Attestation
classes.verifier_does: verifies a signature from the party who benefited — their own key, or their mail server's

note: What can be claimed under today. Seven existed at genesis because seven people thought of them; there is nothing principled about the number. Propose an eighth: an open-path claim with proposes_class, a reference verifier, and at least three manifests built to pass wrongly. Three strangers run one against the other. No vote, no maintainer.
